svg.title: Four Checks Before a Binding Customer Offer
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-resale-preflight-decisions; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before a Binding Customer Offer; subtitle: Pass each applicable branch; resolve failures before committing spend.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Apply checks to the actual product, buyer, geography, procurement route, and data access. Reseller authorization is a contractual requirement; statutory duties depend on the transaction. The numbered stages are sequential decision nodes, not risk scores.; caption: Store the supporting evidence and decision owner with the opportunity record; a vendor discount alone does not resolve license rights, procurement duties, data access, or collection risk.; stages: label: Distribution rights; value: Authorized product, territory, customer, and license use?; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Yes: attach current vendor authorization and license terms. No: obtain permission or remove the product. 17 U.S.C. 106 governs exclusive rights; do not assume 17 U.S.C. 109 authorizes transfers of cloud subscriptions or every licensed software arrangement.; label: Procurement and payment; value: Valid purchasing route with financeable collection exposure?; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Yes: verify buyer authority, order documents, vendor due dates, and cash coverage. No: revise terms or decline unfunded exposure. For federal purchases, apply FAR 12.212, applicable award clauses such as FAR 52.212-4, and FAR 4.1102 registration requirements and exceptions.; label: Data-processing duties; value: Documented access scope and applicable processing terms?; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Yes: use least-privilege access and a removal checklist. No: complete required contracts before accessing customer data. California Civil Code 1798.100(d) applies to specified disclosures by covered businesses; 16 CFR 314.4(f) addresses covered financial institutions' service-provider oversight.; label: Export and channel exposure; value: Permitted destination and stable documented vendor economics?; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Yes: retain product classification, customer screening evidence, quote expiry, and vendor price protection. No: resolve restrictions or decline the transaction. Assess EAR scope under 15 CFR 734.3 and applicable restrictions under parts 744 and 746; escalate applicable OFAC restrictions before fulfillment.

text.title: Four Checks Before a Binding Customer Offer
text.tspan: Four Checks Before a Binding Customer Offer

circle.title: label: Distribution rights; value: Authorized product, territory, customer, and license use?; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Yes: attach current vendor authorization and license terms. No: obtain permission or remove the product. 17 U.S.C. 106 governs exclusive rights; do not assume 17 U.S.C. 109 authorizes transfers of cloud subscriptions or every licensed software arrangement.

text.title: Yes: attach current vendor authorization and license terms. No: obtain permission or remove the product. 17 U.S.C. 106 governs exclusive rights; do not assume 17 U.S.C. 109 authorizes transfers of cloud subscriptions or every licensed software arrangement.

circle.title: label: Procurement and payment; value: Valid purchasing route with financeable collection exposure?; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Yes: verify buyer authority, order documents, vendor due dates, and cash coverage. No: revise terms or decline unfunded exposure. For federal purchases, apply FAR 12.212, applicable award clauses such as FAR 52.212-4, and FAR 4.1102 registration requirements and exceptions.

text.title: Yes: verify buyer authority, order documents, vendor due dates, and cash coverage. No: revise terms or decline unfunded exposure. For federal purchases, apply FAR 12.212, applicable award clauses such as FAR 52.212-4, and FAR 4.1102 registration requirements and exceptions.

circle.title: label: Data-processing duties; value: Documented access scope and applicable processing terms?; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Yes: use least-privilege access and a removal checklist. No: complete required contracts before accessing customer data. California Civil Code 1798.100(d) applies to specified disclosures by covered businesses; 16 CFR 314.4(f) addresses covered financial institutions' service-provider oversight.

text.title: Yes: use least-privilege access and a removal checklist. No: complete required contracts before accessing customer data. California Civil Code 1798.100(d) applies to specified disclosures by covered businesses; 16 CFR 314.4(f) addresses covered financial institutions' service-provider oversight.

circle.title: label: Export and channel exposure; value: Permitted destination and stable documented vendor economics?; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Yes: retain product classification, customer screening evidence, quote expiry, and vendor price protection. No: resolve restrictions or decline the transaction. Assess EAR scope under 15 CFR 734.3 and applicable restrictions under parts 744 and 746; escalate applicable OFAC restrictions before fulfillment.

text.title: Yes: retain product classification, customer screening evidence, quote expiry, and vendor price protection. No: resolve restrictions or decline the transaction. Assess EAR scope under 15 CFR 734.3 and applicable restrictions under parts 744 and 746; escalate applicable OFAC restrictions before fulfillment.

Assumptions: Apply checks to the actual product, buyer, geography, procurement route, and data access. Reseller authorization is a contractual requirement; statutory duties depend on the transaction. The numbered stages are sequential decision nodes, not risk scores.
